# Gevurah Critique

The Awtsmoos gives every infinite possibility a truthful shore; Awtsmoos.com gains strength when one reusable seam replaces duplicated code at the core.

1. Do not replace Animator's real renderer.
2. Do not replace Nesher's mature NLE.
3. Do not flatten 2D and 3D into one rendering implementation.
4. Preserve peer-owned movie-core.
5. Reuse its seconds-based timing consistently in awtsmoos-studio.
6. Keep Animator production plans in milliseconds because its renderer already expects them.
7. Convert only at adapter boundaries.
8. Make AI output serializable and deterministic.
9. Give every scene/entity stable IDs.
10. Expose capabilities before composition.
11. Make unsupported features diagnosable.
12. Keep UI DOM-safe by default; textContent, not raw HTML.
13. Bind semantic action names instead of inline handlers.
14. Make responsive behavior data-driven.
15. Keep mobile canvas usable by collapsing side panels.
16. Separate canonical procedural recipes from renderer objects.
17. Give generated assets receipts with seed/provenance/quality.
18. Avoid modifying hot legacy procedural wrappers during concurrent work.
19. Demonstrate reuse from the new studio immediately.
20. Produce a short syntax/plan proof before long render.
21. Verify final duration with ffprobe.
22. Sample early/middle/late frames.
23. Browser-test narrow and wide layouts.
24. Re-read every written source.
25. Never call planning or JSON compilation a finished movie.
